header.logo: Official logo (/logo.png or /logo-alt.png), height 36px-40px, subtle hover lift
header.nav_links: Editorial uppercase mono links (Despre, Portofoliu, Noutăți, Contact & Booking) with active pill indicators

hero_section.image_rules: Real photo of BIOXIC, high-contrast portrait orientation, rounded 24px-32px border, soft physical drop shadow, top border light sheen
hero_section.copy: H1: BIOXIC — Music Producer & Founder of Everest Manele. Subtitle: Crafting defining soundscapes from Focșani to the world stage.
hero_section.ctas: Primary: 'Rezervări & Booking' (3D Flame button) | Secondary: 'Ascultă Proiectele' (3D Steel button)

despre_section.content: Authentic biography of 19-year-old producer BIOXIC, founder of Everest Manele label. Focus on innovation, production quality, independent spirit.
despre_section.highlights: Bento statistics grid: 19 Years Old | Focșani Roots | Everest Manele Founder | 100M+ Total Streams

portofoliu_section.type: Everest Manele Label Releases & Production Catalog
portofoliu_section.cards: Editorial cards with vinyl rotation detail on hover, release metadata, producer credits, track preview triggers

noutati_section.cards: Minimalist article cards, date stamps, category badges, subtle hover elevation

contact_booking_section.form_inputs: Recessed tactile input fields (input-recessed) with light inset shadow and warm focused glow
contact_booking_section.integrations: Official booking email, Discord link, PayPal support, direct WhatsApp / phone contact info

footer.typography: Massive background brand wordmark 'BIOXIC' in light neutral gradient, copyright info, Everest Manele label links, social media handles

media_assets.rules: ONLY use real existing assets in public folder (/artist.jpg, /logo.png, /logo-alt.png). NEVER use stock photos or fake external artist imagery.

accessibility_and_quality.testing: All interactive elements (buttons, links, form inputs, navigation items, player controls) MUST include kebab-case data-testid attributes (e.g. data-testid="booking-submit-button").
accessibility_and_quality.reduced_motion: Support prefers-reduced-motion media query by disabling continuous animations or spinning vinyls.
accessibility_and_quality.contrast: Ensure minimum 4.5:1 text contrast for body copy and 3:1 for large display headers against #FBF9F5 background.
accessibility_and_quality.file_type_rule: The codebase uses .js / .jsx React files (CRA single index.css + Tailwind).

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Replace dark color variables in index.css with the Light Editorial Luxury palette token values provided.
2. Implement 3D physical button styles (btn-flame, btn-steel, knob) with explicit 150-250ms transitions, subtle top highlights, and press down transform.
3. Restructure the homepage and secondary views into a clean, editorial luxury layout for artist BIOXIC and Everest Manele label.
4. Maintain data-testid attributes across all interactive components for test verification.
5. Use only the real local images /artist.jpg, /logo.png, /logo-alt.png.
